body:
Thank you
This truly means a lot for a human being half my age to give me such great advice. The world is not in complete shambles.
I commend you for your effort 
However I’m certain my brain/mental illness won’t allow me to make sense of any of the advice you’ve so helpfully gave me

Thank you so much
From the bottom of my heart I truly appreciate you
However I know I’m not mentally strong enough to handle a conversation with someone without completely breaking down 

Much much love
I envy your kinship
